_help: Hand-written notes for the Open-source contributions table, read by scripts/upstream.py.
projects: display name, one-line description and link for a repo, or for every repo of an
owner with 'owner/*'. Projects listed here come first, in this order; new ones follow.
pull_requests: the sentence shown for a merged PR. Several PRs can share one sentence by
listing them together. A merged PR without a sentence shows its cleaned-up title, but only
if it merged after curated_until; older ones were reviewed by hand and stay out.
issues: issue links GitHub doesn't know about (the PR body has no 'Closes #...'), and the
sentence for a reported issue that the maintainers fixed.
hide: repos ('owner/repo' or 'owner/*') and items ('owner/repo#123') never shown.
since: PRs and issues opened before this date are ignored.
